CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56331  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Southeast Resource Recovery
  Facility (SERRF) meeting of Tuesday, March 4, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56332  Recommendation to authorize staff to sell equipment or parts on the SERRF site
  when market value exceeds estimated scrap value, with proceeds applied to offset
  demolition costs, and authorize the execution of agreements with potential buyers
  necessary to allow such buyers to enter the SERRF site and remove such
  equipment and parts.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56333  Recommendation to receive, adopt, and file the SERRF Status Report that
  provides updates on the progress of the SERRF site.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Southeast Resource Recovery Facility (SERRF) on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
